title: Description; Category and Vendor truncate on hover; Part # never does
preconds:
1. A part with a very long description (and a long category and vendor name) has in-window activity.
  2. A part with a long part number exists.
  3. You are on the Parts Velocity report with those parts visible.
steps:
1. Look at the long Description, Category, and Vendor cells.
  2. Hover each truncated cell.
  3. Look at the long Part # cell.
expected:
1. Long Description, Category, and Vendor text is truncated with an ellipsis on screen.
2. The full value shows on native hover (browser tooltip).
3. Part # is NEVER truncated - on screen (and in the exports).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Parts Velocity report specification version 11 (S3-R7), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.
